text: Resolved DECISION-2 in favour of a fourth kind rather than a lifecycle state, on evidence rather than preference: Claim.Kind is never assigned outside construction anywhere in internal/, verification wraps a claim in ResolvedClaim without touching it, and AC3 requires contradicted to be immutable after recording. A value that never changes was being proposed as a lifecycle field

verified_by.ref: no assignment to .Kind outside construction in internal/
